name: repository-evidence

items.claim: A probability sum of 1.015 is within the sum-check tolerance, assuming the other checks pass.
This validator requires the probability sum to equal exactly 1 with zero tolerance.
The production provider always returns probability sums of exactly 1.
The configured TypeSafe backend has automatic retries disabled.
If the API key is missing, this function creates a mock backend that returns successful judgments.
The external provider has guaranteed 99.99 percent availability.
For evidence input with 10 items of which 3 fail the local quote check, the 7 remaining questions fit into one backend judge call.
For evidence input with 10 items of which 3 fail the local quote check, all 10 claims are still sent to the backend.
The current live service processes every batch in less than one second.
Unknown top-level properties on the evidence input are rejected by the strict schema.
An extraction request with 9 fields is accepted by this schema.
All supported coding hosts use identical tokenizer rules for these schemas.
A selected candidate with an unknown required condition is marked for review.
The selected candidate is accepted without review whenever the selection confidence is high, even if a required condition is contradicted.
A result not marked for review is always semantically correct on real-world inputs.
An output receipt that already exists is not silently overwritten by this CLI.
The CLI interprets exit code 0 as proof that all supplied claims are true.
Receipt files are automatically uploaded to a central audit database after creation.
